label: Context defines the scope of broad words
explanation: Frigaliment examines the parties’ poultry agreement through communications, trade usage, regulatory language, price evidence, and the buyer’s burden of proof. Small examines a statute through domestic context and competing uses of legislative history. Both accounts show why the domain of a broad word requires explanation. Evidence of commercial agreement and evidence of congressional meaning have different legal roles; neither case makes the other course’s interpretive test controlling.
